title: 第4章 四式怪招
content_zh:
曹虎哈哈一笑，指着站在墙头的一列黑衣汉子说：“弟兄们饿了几天肚子啦，想请岳老板赏口饭吃。”岳胜说：“曹寨主言重了。小兵，取五万过来，请曹寨主赏赐弟兄们。”他这是按江湖规矩行事，但瞧对方的神情声势，决非五万所能打发。

    果然曹虎仰天哈哈大笑说：“岳老板出马，一运就是价值三百万的货。姓曹的眼界虽小，区区五万，倒还不放在眼内。”岳胜心中嘀咕：“此人信息倒灵，怎么打听得清清楚楚，知道我送的货价值三百万？”眉头一皱，仍按江湖规矩说：“姓岳的本事低微，全凭道上朋友给脸罢了。曹寨主今日虽初见，咱们东边不会西边会，岳某有幸，今日又多交一位朋友了。不知曹寨主有什么吩咐？”

    曹虎说：“吩咐嘛是不敢当，只是在下生来见财开眼，钱财打从鼻子下过，不取有伤阴德。但岳老板既开口朋友，闭口朋友，这样吧，在下只取一半，二一添作五，就借一百五十万花差花差好了。”也不等岳胜答话，左手一挥，墙头八名大汉纷纷跃下，奔到厅口。有人问：“都取了？”曹虎说：“不，拿一半，留一半！有屎大家拉，有饭大家吃！”大汉们哄然答应，就往货车走去。

    岳胜勃然大怒，见那些大汉从墙头跃下时身手呆滞，并没高手在内，已无担忧之心，淡淡说：“曹寨主是不肯留一点余地了？”曹虎愕然说：“怎么不留余地？我不是说取一半，留一半？哥俩有商有量，公平交易！”

    周银兵再也忍耐不住，抢上两步，伸手指着曹虎大声说：“亏你在黑道上行走，没听过海安物流的名字么？”曹虎说：“翻船物流嘛，我小媳妇倒听见过。他妈的，海安物流老子却第一次听见。”身形一晃，忽地欺到厅右，拔下插在货车上的海安镖旗，将旗杆一折两段，掷在地下，随即伸脚在旗上一顿踩。

    这件事当真犯了江湖大忌，劫货的事情常有，却极少有如此做到绝的，如非双方有解不开的死仇，那是决心性命相拼了。海安众人一见之下，顿时大哗。

    周银兵更不答话，冲上去一招“踏步击掌”，左掌向他胸口猛击过去。曹虎侧身闪避，说道：“小子，动手么？”左掌反过，急抓他手腕。周银兵变“后插步摆掌”，左手向后勾挂，右掌向上摆举，径击敌人下颚。曹虎头一偏，右拳直击下来。这拳来路极怪，周银兵急忙摆头让开，砰的一声，肩头已中了一拳，但觉拳力沉重，只震得胸背隐隐作痛。周银兵脚步摇晃，险些摔倒，幸亏他身强力壮，下盘马步扎得极稳，忙变“扑腿穿掌”，身子微矮，右腿屈膝蹲下，左掌穿出，那是卸力反攻，查拳的高明招数。

    曹虎并不理会，微微一笑，左腿反钩，向后倒踢，这一腿更加古怪。周银兵大骇，急忙蹿上跃避。曹虎右拳直击，喝道：“恭喜发财！”砰的一响，正中他胸口。这拳好厉害，周银兵仰天一跤跌倒，在地下连打了几个滚，哇的一声吐出一口鲜血，极硬朗的一个小伙子，竟给这拳打得站不起身。群盗哄然喝彩，叫道：“这拳够这愣小子挨的。”

    岳胜走上两步，抱拳说：“曹寨主果然好武艺，多谢教训了犬子，也好让他知道江湖上尽多能人。”曹虎笑着说：“我这几下三脚猫算什么玩意，给你岳老板提皮鞋、倒便壶也还挨不上边儿，只好哄哄人家小媳妇。光棍别的不会，你奶奶的，就只会这个，这就请百胜拳赐教！”岳胜见他满脸油光，说话贫嘴滑舌，不折不扣是个泼皮无赖，怎么又练就了这样一身怪异武功，当真奇怪，打定主意先行只守不攻，待认清他拳路再说，当下凝神斜立，双手虚握。

    三警员、温文新、海安众人一起凝神观斗，都知这场争斗不但关系到三百万货物的安危，也是岳胜身家性命、一生威望之所系。大厅中人人肃静，只听火堆中柴炭爆裂，发出轻轻的噼啪声。院子中大雨如注，竟无半分停息之意。那男子和美妇并肩低声说话，对岳胜和曹虎的争斗似乎全没留心。

    曹虎从怀中取出个晶莹碧绿的翡翠鼻烟壶，伸手指蘸了些鼻烟吸了口，慢慢将鼻烟壶放回怀中，就像赌场上赌徒要下重注之前的姿势一般。他也知岳胜绝非庸手，将衣袖紧了紧，叫道：“光棍祖上不积德，吃饭就得拼老命！他奶奶的这就拼啊！”忽然猱身直上，左拳猛出向岳胜击去。

    岳胜待他拳头离胸半尺，一个“白鹤亮翅”，身子已向左转成弓箭步，两臂向后成钩手，呼的一声轻响，倒挥出来，平举反击，使的仍是少林派中极为寻常的查拳，但架式凝稳，出手抬腿之际，甚为老练狠辣。

    那男子对海安物流与强盗的争斗本来并不在意，偶然斜眼一瞥，正见到曹虎一足反踢，招式奇特，不由留神观看。那美妇叫道：“丰粮，丰粮！”那男子随口漫应，目光却贯注于二人的拼斗。那美妇伸手摇了摇他肩膀说：“一个糟老头子和一个泼皮混混打架，当真就这么好看吗？”那男子听她话中大有不悦之意，忙转头笑着说：“这混混的拳脚好古怪。”那美妇叹气说：“唉，你们男人，天下最要紧的事就是杀人打架。”那男子笑着说：“你不许我看，我就不看。那你向着我，让我把你美丽的脸蛋瞧个饱。”那美妇低低一笑，甚为娇媚，果真抬起了头望他。两人四目交投，脸上都充满了柔情蜜意。

    这时岳胜与那盗魁已斗得如火如荼，甚为激烈。岳胜的一路查拳堪堪打完，仍占不到半点上风，曹虎的拳脚来来去去只十几招，或伸拳直击，或钩腿反踢，或沉肘擒拿，或劈掌夹腿。三警员看了一阵，早察觉他招数有限，但岳胜居然就是战他不下，都觉好笑。

    眼见岳胜使一招“马裆推拳”，跨腿成骑马势，右手抽回，左手向前猛推。田星辰叫道：“沉肘擒拿。”果然不出所料，曹虎手肘一沉，就施擒拿手抓他手腕。岳胜急忙变招，手臂缩回，微微转身。田星辰笑着说：“钩腿反踢！”曹虎果然勾起右腿，向后反踢。岳胜的武功高出田星辰不知多少，田星辰既已事先瞧出，他岂有料不到之理？但说也奇怪，明知对手要钩腿反踢，竟没法以伏招破解。岳胜号称百胜拳，少林派各路拳术全部烂熟于胸，见查拳奈何不得对方，招数一变，突然快打快踢，拳势如风，旁观者顿时目为之眩，他使的是一路燕青拳。

    浪子燕青是北宋时期梁山泊好汉，当年相扑之技，天下无对。这路拳法传下来，讲究纵跃起伏，盘拗挑打，全是进手招数。岳胜年纪虽老，身手仍极矫捷，蹿高伏低，宛如狸猫相似。曹虎见敌人变招，仍以那十几招又笨拙又难看的拳脚翻来覆去地使用。

    温文新、周银兵、岳青，以及海安师傅们见这盗魁的武功如此古怪，都诧异万分。每个人到此时都已料到他下一招是伸拳直击，还是劈掌夹腿，心里不禁都随着田星辰叫了出来，但岳胜竟奈何他不得。只见岳胜“上步进肘掴身拳”、“迎面抢快打三拳”、“左右跨打”、“反身裁锤”、“踢腿撩阴十字拳”，一招接一招，犹如门外的狂风暴雨一般。但曹虎只一招毛手毛脚地伸臂直击，就将他所有巧妙的招式尽数破解了。

    那破衣乞丐和男孩一直蜷缩在屋内角落，瞧着岳胜和曹虎比武。乞丐低声说：“你仔细瞧好那个强盗，要瞧仔细了，千万别忘了他的相貌！”男孩问：“干嘛要瞧他？”乞丐说：“你记着这人，永远别忘记了。”男孩问：“他是个大坏人么？”乞丐咬牙切齿说：“阴差阳错，叫咱们在这里撞见了他。你瞧清楚了，可别让他知觉。”

    过了一会，乞丐又说：“你总说功夫练得不顺手，你仔细瞧着他，也许就对了。”男孩问：“为什么呀？”乞丐眼中微有泪光，低声说：“现在还不能说，等你年纪大了，武艺练好了，我原原本本说给你听。”

    男孩看曹虎拳打脚踢，姿势极其难看，但隐隐似有所悟，忽然叫出声来。乞丐忙说：“别大声嚷嚷。”男孩“嗯”了声答应，低声说：“这个人的拳脚我有些懂啦。”乞丐说：“不错，你好好瞧着。你那本《北斗秘籍》前面缺了两页，所以你总说练不顺。那缺了的两页，就在这曹虎身上。”

    男孩吃了一惊，小脸蛋上现出一些红晕，目不转睛地望着曹虎，又问：“怎么会在他身上？”乞丐说：“将来会跟你说。这家伙本来不会什么武功，但得了两页纸，学会了十几招残缺不全的拳法，竟能跟鼎鼎有名的老拳师打成平手，你想想，那《北斗秘籍》共有三百多页，等你将来学会了，学全了，能有多大的本事。”男孩听了心中激动，眼睛里闪耀着兴奋的光芒。
content_en:
Cao Hu laughed loudly, pointed at the row of black-clothed men standing on the wall and said, "Brothers have been hungry for a few days, and I would like to ask Boss Yue to give me some food." Yue Sheng said, "Master Cao's words are serious. Soldier, come here with 50,000, and ask Master Cao to reward the brothers." He was acting according to the rules of the world, but looking at the other party's expression and momentum, it was definitely not something he could spend with 50,000.
Sure enough, Cao Hu looked up to the sky and laughed loudly and said: "Boss Yue came out and shipped goods worth three million. Although Cao's vision is small, only fifty thousand is not in his eyes." Yue Sheng muttered in his heart: "This person's information is not good, how can he find out clearly and know the price of the goods I sent?"Worth three million?" He frowned and said according to the rules of the world: "My surname is Yue, and I just rely on my friends on the road to give him credit.Although we are meeting each other for the first time today, we will not meet each other in the east.Yue is lucky to have made another friend today."
Cao Hu said: "I don't dare to take orders. I just want to open my eyes to wealth in the next life. If money passes under my nose, it will hurt my moral character. But Boss Yue is both open to friends and silent to friends. So, let me take half of it, add it to five by two, and borrow 1.5 million to spend the difference." Without waiting for Yue Sheng to reply, he waved his left hand, and eight big men on the wall jumped down one after another and ran to the entrance of the hall.Someone asked: "Take them all?" Cao Hu said: "No, take half and keep half! If there is shit, everyone will poop, and if there is food, everyone will eat!" The big men agreed enthusiastically and walked to the truck.
Yue Sheng was furious. When he saw the sluggish movements of those big men jumping down from the wall, and there were no masters among them, he no longer had any worries. He said calmly: "Master Cao is not willing to leave a little room?" Cao Hu said in shock: "Why not leave room? I didn't say take half and keep half? The two brothers have discussed and negotiated, fair deal!"
Zhou Yinbing couldn't bear it anymore, took two steps forward, pointed at Cao Hu and said loudly: "You are walking on the underworld, haven't you heard the name of Haian Logistics?" Cao Hu said: "Shipwreck Logistics, my little wife has heard of it. Damn it, Haian Logistics is the first time I heard it." With a sway, he suddenly bullied the right side of the hall, pulled out the Haian escort flag inserted in the truck, folded the flagpole in two, threw it to the ground, and then stretched out his foot to step on the flag.
This matter is really a taboo in the world. Robbery of goods is common, but it is rarely done to such an extreme degree. If the two parties had not had an irresolvable hatred, they would have decided to fight for their lives.When everyone in Hai'an saw it, they immediately burst into an uproar.
Zhou Yinbing didn't even answer. He rushed forward and struck him in the chest with his left palm.Cao Hu dodged sideways and said, "Boy, do you want to do something?" He turned his left palm around and grabbed his wrist.Zhou Yin's mutiny "steps behind and swings the palm", hooks his left hand backward, swings his right palm upward, and strikes the enemy's jaw directly.Cao Hu tilted his head and struck straight with his right fist.The punch came from a very strange direction. Zhou Yinbing hurriedly shook his head to get out of the way. With a bang, he was hit on the shoulder. However, he felt that the force of the punch was heavy, and it only caused a dull pain in his chest and back.Zhou Yinbing's steps were shaky and he almost fell down. Fortunately, he was strong and his horse stance was extremely stable. He quickly changed into a "throwing leg and piercing the palm". His body was short, he bent his right leg and squatted down, and thrust out with his left palm. This was a clever move to counterattack and check the punch.
Cao Hu ignored it, smiled slightly, hooked his left leg, and kicked backwards. This leg was even weirder.Zhou Yinbing was horrified and hurriedly jumped up to avoid it.Cao Hu hit him with his right fist and shouted: "Congratulations on getting rich!" With a bang, it hit him in the chest.This punch was so powerful that Zhou Yinbing fell backwards and rolled several times on the ground. He spit out a mouthful of blood with a loud sound. This extremely tough young man could not stand up due to this punch.The gang of thieves cheered loudly and shouted: "This punch is enough for this stupid kid."
Yue Sheng took two steps, clasped his fists and said, "Captain Cao is really good at martial arts. Thank you for teaching Quanzi a lesson so that he can know as many capable people as possible." Cao Hu said with a smile, "What a three-legged cat I am these days. I can't carry leather shoes or empty a chamber pot for your boss Yue, so I have to coax his little wife. I'm a bachelor and don't know anything else., Your grandma only knows this, please teach me about Yuan Shengquan!" Yue Sheng saw that his face was oily and his words were smooth. He was a scoundrel. How could he practice such a weird martial arts? It was really strange. He made up his mind to only defend but not attack until he could figure out his fists. He stood attentively and clasped his hands.
The three police officers, Wen Wenxin, and everyone in Hai'an watched the fight attentively. They all knew that this fight was not only related to the safety of three million goods, but also the fate of Yue Sheng's wealth, life, and prestige.Everyone in the hall was silent, except for the soft crackling sound of charcoal exploding in the fire.The rain was pouring heavily in the yard, with no sign of letting up.The man and the beautiful woman spoke in low voices side by side, seemingly not paying attention to the fight between Yue Sheng and Cao Hu.
Cao Hu took out a crystal green emerald snuff bottle from his arms, dipped his finger in some snuff and inhaled, then slowly put the snuff bottle back into his arms, just like a gambler in a casino before making a big bet.He also knew that Yue Sheng was by no means mediocre, so he tightened his sleeves and shouted: "If you are a bachelor, if you don't have any good deeds, you will have to fight for your life to eat! His grandma will fight hard now!" Suddenly, he straightened up and punched Yue Sheng with his left fist.
When Yue Sheng waited for his fist to be half a foot away from his chest, he made a "White Crane with Spreading Wings". His body had turned to the left into a lunge, his arms were back into hooks, and with a soft cry, he swung it backwards and raised it flat to counterattack. He still used the extremely common Cha Fist in the Shaolin School, but his posture was stable, and when he shot and raised his leg, he was very experienced and ruthless.
The man originally didn't care about the fight between Haian Logistics and the bandits. He accidentally glanced sideways and saw Cao Hu kicking back with a strange move. He couldn't help but watch carefully.The beautiful woman shouted: "Feng Liang, Feng Liang!" The man responded casually, but his eyes were focused on the fight between the two.The beautiful woman stretched out her hand and shook his shoulder and said, "A bad old man fighting with a naughty gangster, is it really that good to watch?" The man was very displeased when he heard her words. He turned around and said with a smile, "This gangster's fists and kicks are so weird." The beautiful woman sighed and said, "Oh"You men, the most important thing in the world is killing and fighting."The man said with a smile: "If you don't let me look, I won't. Then look at me and let me take a good look at your beautiful face."The beautiful woman smiled very charmingly and raised her head to look at him.The two of them looked at each other, their faces full of tenderness and sweetness.
At this time, Yue Sheng and the bandit chief were already fighting in full swing, and it was very fierce.Yue Sheng's punches were beaten all the way, but he still couldn't gain the slightest advantage. Cao Hu's punches and kicks came and went with only a dozen moves, some extending his fists to strike directly, some hooking and kicking back, some elbowing to grab, or splitting his hands and legs.The three police officers watched for a while and realized that his tricks were limited, but Yue Sheng actually couldn't defeat him, which was funny to them all.
Seeing Yue Sheng use the "horse crotch push punch" move, he crossed his legs into a riding position, withdrew his right hand and pushed forward with his left hand.Tian Xingchen shouted: "Sink your elbow to capture." As expected, Cao Hu's elbow sank and he grabbed his wrist with his grasping hand.Yue Sheng hurriedly changed his stance, retracted his arm and turned slightly.Tian Xingchen smiled and said: "Hook leg kick!" As expected, Cao Hu hooked his right leg and kicked back.Yue Sheng's martial arts is much higher than Tian Xingchen's. Since Tian Xingchen has seen it in advance, how could he not expect it?But strangely enough, he knew his opponent was going to hook his leg and kick back, but he couldn't break it with an ambush move.Yue Sheng is known as Yue Sheng Fist, and he is familiar with all the boxing techniques of the Shaolin School. Seeing that Zha Quan can't help the opponent, he changed his moves and suddenly struck and kicked quickly. The punches were as powerful as the wind. The onlookers were immediately dazzled. He used the Yanqing Quan.
The prodigal Yan Qing was a hero in Liangshan during the Northern Song Dynasty. His sumo wrestling skills at that time were unparalleled in the world.This style of boxing has been passed down from generation to generation, emphasizing vertical jumps, twists and turns, and punches, all of which are attacking moves.Although Yue Sheng is old, he is still extremely agile, jumping up and down like a civet cat.When Cao Hu saw the enemy changing his moves, he still used those dozen clumsy and ugly fists and kicks over and over again.
Wen Wenxin, Zhou Yinbing, Yue Qing, and the Hai'an masters were all surprised when they saw the weird martial arts of the bandit leader.By this time, everyone had already expected whether his next move would be a direct strike with a fist, or a split palm and a leg, and they couldn't help but scream along with Tian Xingchen in their hearts, but Yue Sheng actually couldn't do anything to him.I saw Yue Sheng's "step forward, elbow and body punch", "front-on attack and three quick punches", "left and right straddle punch", "reflex hammer attack", "kick and cross punch", one after another, like a violent storm outside the door.But Cao Hu defeated all his ingenious moves with just one quick attack with outstretched arms.
The beggar in rags and the boy had been huddled in the corner of the house, watching the competition between Yue Sheng and Cao Hu.The beggar whispered: "Look carefully at that robber. Look carefully and don't forget his appearance!" The boy asked: "Why do you want to look at him?" The beggar said: "Remember this man and never forget him." The boy asked: "Is he a bad guy?" The beggar gritted his teeth and said, "By some strange combination of circumstances, we bumped into him here. You can see clearly, but don't let him know."
After a while, the beggar said again: "You always say that you are not good at Kung Fu. If you look at him carefully, you may be right." The boy asked, "Why?" There were tears in the beggar's eyes, and he whispered: "I can't tell you now. When you are older and have mastered Kung Fu, I will tell you the truth."
The boy saw Cao Hu punching and kicking him in an extremely ugly posture, but he seemed to have some realization and suddenly cried out.The beggar hurriedly said: "Don't yell so loudly." The boy agreed with "Yes" and whispered: "I know a little bit about this man's fists and kicks." The beggar said: "Yes, you should take a good look at it. There are two pages missing in the front of your "Beidou Secret Book", so you always say that the practice is not going well. The two missing pages belong to Cao Hu."
The boy was startled, with some blush on his little face. He looked at Cao Hu intently and asked, "Why is it happening to him?" The beggar said, "I will tell you in the future. This guy didn't know any martial arts, but he got two pages and learned more than a dozen incomplete moves.Quan's boxing skills are actually on a par with the famous old boxer. Think about it, the "Beidou Secrets" has more than 300 pages.When you learn it in the future, how capable you will be." The boy was excited after hearing this, and his eyes were shining with excitement.
